windows.title: RemainingTimeNotify
windows.summary: The staging/phase countdown notify (ui/Config/Default/RemainingTimeNotify.ini + .lua, PakV4, recovered 2026-10-02): anchored TOPCENTER,0,150; Open(nSeconds) renders the remaining time as big RougeLike.UITex digit frames (frame = digit 0-9, verified frame 3 shows the digit 3) and auto-closes ~5s (OnFrameBreathe); n%60==0 shows Image_Minute + the minutes digits, otherwise Image_Second + the seconds (the lua switches the 分/秒 labels; SFX_Num plays ROUGELIKE_KILL<digit>.pss per digit; Scene/MapWindow8 frames the label). Static render = the 30s state (seconds mode, digits 3/0). The staging phase therefore DOES have displays: this notify (server-driven remaining time), the mode notice panel BattleFieldHSLHNotice (黑山绝境 event notices e.g. 毒蘑菇即将出现/方位提示), and the phase announcements (绝境将在30/20/10秒后开始) which arrive as system messages and render on MainMessageLine (5.8); the safe-zone boundary is engine-drawn (MapCircle + SFX_CircleNew) and BattleFieldMap.Text_Time stays hidden for treasure maps.

The my-team rows clone Handle_Player inside Handle_FinalList (Update: rows = GetMyTeamMemberData(nTeamID) sorted by field 12; TemplateGetRowData maps Name->Text_PlayerName, DECAPITATE_COUNT->Text_KillNum, KILL_COUNT->Text_XSNum, BEST_ASSIST_KILL_COUNT->Text_BestZGNum, HARM_OUTPUT->Text_HarmNum, SPECIAL_OP_3->Text_JJFenNum, SPECIAL_OP_6->Text_ResultNum; per-row AWARD_1/2/3 in Handle_Reward -> Image_AwardIcon frames on ui/Image/UITga/DesertStorm.UITex + Text_AwardNum). Handle_Fail/Handle_Win carry the ZS ribbon state art, the header labels live in Handle_Titile (STR_FBLIST_DUIYUANMINGZI/STR_TIPS7/STR_BF_KILL1/STR_BF_ZJZG/STR_BF_DAMAGE/STR_SHOW/STR_SHOW2/STR_GETCITY_JIANGLI), Text_Time = STR_BATTLEFIELD_TIME_USED, Text_WarningTime = STR_NEW_BANISH_1..2 banishing countdown, Btn_Leave -> LeaveALLBattleField (Text_Leave = STR_UISET_BFCENCEL), Btn_Export -> ExportData (Text_Export = STR_FACELIST_DAOCHUMIANJU, STR_CONTENST_INFO_EXPORT_SUCCESS), Wnd_PersonCard opens the clicked member's PersonalCard. Sample rows are placeholders in the window's real formats: Text_Line = '/' so Text_KillNum+Line+XSNum read as the 击/助 pair, Text_BestZGNum = 最佳助攻, Text_HarmNum is 万-formatted, Text_JJFenNum = 本场表现分, Text_ResultNum = 个人评分结算; the rank badge keeps the INI's authored digits (第18名) and Text_Rank carries the matching 队伍排名 text. The PVPUI12 chrome (LockShowAndHide=1) stays off. The window ships no opaque background: its only backdrop art is the semi-transparent veil Image_Bg1 (PVPShowFinal1 frame 11, ImageType=12, ~23% alpha) plus the row bands, composed over the live game world on the client, so the viewer renders it over a neutral tone (`backdrop` #33393E) instead of black; with the personal-card column out of scope the table block is centered on the window (Handle_Titile 403, Handle_FinalList 415). Verified against the capture (downscaled 1/1.73 to design px): button labels follow the engine's WndButton NormalFont, not the child Text scheme (Btn_Leave scheme 3 = 16px white, Btn_Export scheme 18 = 15px white - the authored Text_Leave 28/Text_Export 27 are copy-paste leftovers; 25% of shipped buttons differ), the banishing countdown is the runtime AppendItemFromString sequence in Handle_WarningTime (将在 f257 / seconds f258 yellow2 / 秒后传出战场 f257, viewer `appends` with flow), and the 击/助 pair packs tight because Text_Line is AutoSize=1 PosType=9 (the viewer now measures AutoSize text instead of using the authored box). 导出数据 is hidden per the user's call (the capture shows it, but the viewer drops it: hide Btn_Export). The window is a full-screen overlay centred on the screen (the editor parks the root at (screen-window)/2), so the viewer renders it inside a 1920x1080 screen frame (`screenWidth`/`screenHeight`) with the window centred on the neutral backdrop - the veil reads as the in-game band instead of filling the render.

windows.summary: Client exit / return confirm dialog (420x108, anchored TOPCENTER,TOPCENTER,0,360 below the screen top; ShowModeID 27,26,24,22,12,36). OpenExitPanel(szReason) sets Text_ExitGame from g_tStrings: close -> EXIT_QUIT 你确定要退出游戏吗？, loginclose -> EXIT_LOGIN_QUIT 你确定要退出游戏吗？, returntologin -> EXIT_RETURN_LOGIN 你确定要返回到登录吗？, returntorole -> EXIT_RETURN_CHOOSE 你确定要返回到角色选择吗？ (ExitPanel.lua). Btn_Sure (确定, STR_SURE) exits the game / ReInitUI by the reason, Btn_Cancel (取消, STR_CANCEL) plus Esc/Enter close it. Image_Back is a runtime full-screen dimmer: UpdateBgImageSize sizes it to Station.GetClientSize() and pins it to the window origin; it stays hidden in the static render (screen context, like the world backdrop). The warning icon and the glass PanelBg/PanelBg18 ornaments come from UItimate. The shipped Text_ExitGame leaves HAlign at the left default although its 241-wide box is glued to the icon (76..348, group centred on the 420 dialog) and no shipped reason fills it, so the viewer centres the message in its box (`adjust hAlign=1`) and moves the icon to the message's left edge (Image_Warning left=124, the authored 76 assumed a full-width message); re-open when a capture of the live dialog is available.
elements: 你确定要退出游戏吗？ prompt (Text_ExitGame, runtime-set from EXIT_*)
确定 / 取消 buttons (Btn_Sure / Btn_Cancel)
Runtime full-screen dimmer (Image_Back, client-size at runtime)

windows.title: MapQueue
windows.summary: Per-map queue rows with elapsed time, cancel menu and the auto-enter checkbox; fed by OnSyncMapQueueInfo. Handle_Content/_0 are parked prototypes cloned per queued map by AppendItemFromIni into Handle_List, so the default hides them and injects one authored row. UpdateListSize (MapQueue.decompiled.lua:667-745) resizes the list/bg/checkbox from the row count and then calls Collapse (lua:330-376), which sets the window to 32 + rows*48 + 32 (112 for one row) and shows Wnd_List; the inventory adjust list carries those one-row values.
elements: Per-map queue rows + 点击取消排队 context menu
